meta.title: Weighted RRF sensitivity (not tuning; no weight is chosen)
meta.intro: Hybrid = Python RRF (k=60) with the dense list weighted 1, 1.5 or 2 and the BM25 list weighted 1. Weight 1 is the baseline fusion (reproduces the baseline hybrid rows exactly: True). bm25 and dense rows are repeated for reference.

extra_md: ## Weighted RRF: change in the rank of the first expected doc relative to weight 1 (the baseline fusion)
Reported for every weight; no weight is picked. wins = the weighted fusion ranks the first expected doc better than weight 1.
